caption: Figure 5.4: How Wakis sets the CFL time step Δt across its three mesh families. Left: on uniform or graded Cartesian grids (SolverFIT3D), Δt is governed by the minimum cell dimensions (Δx_min, Δy_min, Δz_min) and Courant factor cfln (default 0.5). Centre: with conformal Dey–Mittra PEC (conformal='pec'), symmetric flux redistribution on small cut faces keeps the stable step at 0.85–0.97 of the uncut Yee limit (studies/conformal-pec-mask/). Right: on unstructured simplex, polygon, and prism meshes, Δt is set from the maximum eigenvalue λ_max of M_ε⁻¹ Cᵀ M_ν C.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G and its quantities in blue, dual grid G-tilde and its quantities in orange, exact/topological items in dark grey, approximate/material items in green, failure or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Three equal panels in a row. LEFT PANEL (blue border, heading '1. Uniform & Nonuniform Cartesian (SolverFIT3D)'): a graded 2D Cartesian grid patch where the narrowest cell is highlighted in blue and labelled 'Δx_min, Δy_min, Δz_min'. Below the grid, the exact equation 'Δt = cfln / (c₀ √(1/Δx_min² + 1/Δy_min² + 1/Δz_min²))' and three stacked parameter badges: blue badge 'default cfln = 0.5 (2× margin for graded grids, CPML, lumped, ADE)', green badge 'vacuum / dielectric: cfln = 0.9 or 0.95', dark grey badge 'scheme="tete": cfln = 1.0'. CENTRE PANEL (green border, heading '2. Conformal Dey–Mittra PEC (conformal="pec")'): a Cartesian cell cut by a smooth curved grey PEC boundary leaving a small cut face (shaded light orange) with a green arrow redistributing flux to its stable in-plane neighbours. Below the drawing: 'small cut faces stabilized by symmetric flux redistribution' and a green badge 'measured stable Δt: 0.85–0.97 of uncut Yee limit (studies/conformal-pec-mask/)'. RIGHT PANEL (orange border, heading '3. Unstructured Simplex, Polygon & Prism'): a small unstructured triangle/polygon/prism mesh patch next to the operator badge 'M_ε⁻¹ Cᵀ M_ν C  →  λ_max'. Below, the exact equation 'Δt = cfl · 2 / √λ_max' and two parameter badges: blue badge 'UnstructuredFIT2D, PolygonFIT2D, PrismFIT3D, UnstructuredFIT3D: default cfl = 0.95' and orange badge 'DGTD2D: default cfl = 0.8 (LSRK stability region)'.
